name: Unrequited Love

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can sail from Auberdine in Darkshore to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, crossing from Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a dwarf, you know excavation connects Hollee and Tarrel to a trade central to dwarven tradition and study across Azeroth.

faq.answer: Hollee asks travelers in Auberdine, on Darkshore’s coast, to carry a personal note to Tarrel Rockweaver, her former schoolmate. A boat sails from there to Menethil Harbor.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Unrequited Love?

faq.answer: Tarrel Rockweaver is an excavator and Hollee’s former schoolmate. After their studies, he was sent to the Wetlands, where he works near Menethil Harbor with his wife, Merrin.
Merrin is Tarrel Rockweaver’s wife. Hollee hesitates and furrows her brow when she mentions her, though Hollee still loves Tarrel.

aliases: what is unrequited love quest about
why is it called unrequited love
faq.answer: Hollee still loves Tarrel Rockweaver, though he married Merrin. Their years studying excavation together ended with Hollee pining for him in Auberdine, across the sea.
faq.q: Why is the quest called Unrequited Love?

faq.answer: Tarrel Rockweaver is near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands, across the Great Sea from Darkshore. A passenger boat carries you from Auberdine to the harbor docks.
You carry Hollee’s Note to Tarrel Rockweaver in the Wetlands, to check on his well-being and deliver her personal message.
faq.q: What item is delivered in this quest?

sections.body: Hollee watches travelers board ships in Auberdine, the port town on Darkshore’s coast. She hopes one bound for the Eastern Kingdoms will carry her message to Tarrel Rockweaver. They studied excavation together for years. Then graduation sent them to opposite continents.
sections.title: A Message Across the Sea

sections.body: Hollee recalls Tarrel’s sharp mind and skill with excavation, but falters when she speaks of his wife, Merrin. Though Tarrel is married and far away, Hollee entrusts you with a personal letter. She asks you to find him near Menethil Harbor and make sure he is safe.
sections.title: Unspoken Feelings

summary: In Auberdine, Hollee sends a personal note across the sea to Tarrel Rockweaver, the classmate she still loves.
